title: Reservoir
tagline: Ranks every parcel in a utility territory for solar + storage, and tracks local moratoria with verified quotes.
description: A site screener for distributed solar + storage origination that scores every parcel for buildability, grid headroom and permitting risk, paired with an LLM-parsed tracker of local siting rules and moratoria.
longDescription:
Built for a two-analyst team originating distributed-generation solar + storage sites by direct search, Reservoir combines two tools in one tabbed Streamlit app.

### 1 · Site Screener

A GeoPandas pipeline pulls parcels, wetlands, flood zones, slope, land cover, protected open space, brownfields, landfills and utility hosting-capacity data, then scores every parcel from 0 to 100 on seven re-weightable components. It favors landfills, brownfields, gravel pits and industrial land. Outputs include a ranked shortlist, a printable one-page site card per parcel and an owner list for outreach.

National Grid publishes feeder attributes but withholds their geometry, so the pipeline rebuilds each three-phase feeder's path from a filtered map image to within about ±12 m.

### 2 · Local Siting & Moratorium Tracker

Claude extracts structured fields from zoning bylaws and local laws: by-right vs. special permit, size caps, setbacks, decommissioning and moratorium dates. Every field needs a verbatim quote, and code checks that the quote is really in the source; if it isn't, the field drops to `unknown`. Moratorium status is re-derived from dates in code, proposed laws never change a score, and LLM output never overwrites a human-verified record.

A 20-town accuracy check measures field-level error rates by type. It shows 0/20 until a person completes it, because an invented accuracy number would defeat the purpose.

tourSteps.title: Feeders colored by headroom
tourSteps.body: The Map tab shows the National Grid Blackstone Valley pilot. Three-phase feeders are colored by available hosting capacity.

tourSteps.title: Re-weight live
tourSteps.body: Raise **feeder headroom** in the sidebar and watch gravel pits on zero-headroom feeders drop down the shortlist.

tourSteps.title: One-page site cards
tourSteps.body: Each parcel gets a card with acreage, buildable area, nearest feeder, permitting status and owner. Print it to PDF for one page per site.

tourSteps.title: Quotes are checked, not trusted
tourSteps.body: The Siting tracker shows each extracted field with its verbatim quote. A quote that isn't in the source downgrades the field to `unknown`.

tourSteps.title: Accuracy stays blank until a person checks
tourSteps.body: The 20-town accuracy check reports error rates by type (omission, hallucination, wrong value, stale, entity confusion, unit) once it's been reviewed by hand.
